main.description: Give the group a handle on a domain it owns, once that domain names the group by its _atproto DNS record or its /.well-known/atproto-did; or give it back its own address as its handle. Updates the group's did:plc and tells the network. Its address stays reserved for it. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

handle.description: The new handle: a domain that names the group, or the group's own address.

errors.name: InvalidOperation
errors.description: The PLC directory refused the change, as when another was made first: ask again.
